<script type="text/javascript">
    function customAlert(message){
      var alertContent = '';
      alertContent += '<div class="content-modale in position-fixed top-0 left-0 bottom-0 right-0 p-nav d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center" style="background-color: rgba(255,255,255, 0.8);">';
      alertContent += '<div class="height-modal w-100 w-sm-75 w-lg-50 h-100 p-3">';
      alertContent += '<div class="w-100 d-flex justify-content-end">';
      alertContent += '<button class="h-45px w-45px bg-transparent border-0 p-1" type="button" title="Close info" onclick="closeModale()"><svg class="svg-dark rotate-45"><use xlink:href="#piu"/></svg></button></div>';
      alertContent += '<div class="info-modale bg-white pulse"><div class="h-100 w-100 bg-c2 medium text-md text-space p-3 p-md-5">';
      alertContent += '<p class="mb-2"><span class="d-block bold titolo-highlight">ATTENZIONE!</span></p>';
      alertContent += '<p class="mb-0">' + message + '</p>';
      alertContent += '</div></div></div></div>';
      $('.alert-box').html(alertContent);
    }

    function closeModale() {
      $('.content-modale').toggleClass('out');
    }
</script>

<script>

		$(window).on('afterLoad', function(){


		// lazy loading for external javascript
		$('script.lazyScript[data-src]').each(function(){
			$(this).attr('src',$(this).attr('data-src'));
		});

		// side cart
		$('body').on('click','.box-action-nav .cart',function(){ga('send','event','UX','open side cart',window.location.href);});
		$('.box-action-nav .cart').on('click',function(){
		ga('send','event','UX','open side cart',window.location.href);
		$('.spedizione_gratuira_bar_inner.side').css('transition','none').css('width','0');
		setTimeout(function(){
			var perc = $('.spedizione_gratuira_bar_inner.side').attr('data-value');
			$('.spedizione_gratuira_bar_inner.side').css('transition','all 0.6s ease').css('width',perc+'%');
		},500);
					});

		setTimeout(function(){
			$('.spedizione_gratuira_bar_inner').each(function(){
				var perc = $(this).attr('data-value');
				$(this).css('width',perc+'%');
			});
		},1500);

		$('.ac-widget').on('click',function(e){
			ga('send','event','UX','Help button click',window.location.href);
		});
		/* AJAX BUTTON LISTING PAGE *****************************************************/
		$('.prodloop__addCartButton').on('click',function(e){
			if($(this).attr('disabled')){
				return false;
			}
			var pid = parseInt($(this).attr('data-pid'));
			var qta = parseInt($(this).attr('data-qta'));
			var $avviso = $('.prodloop__notice[data-pid='+pid+']');
			var $button = $(this);
			$(this).attr('disabled','disabled');
			startAjaxBtnAnimation($(this));
			$avviso.html('');
			$.post('/AJAX_add_to_cart.php',{prodotto_id:pid,qta:qta},function(data){
				var response = JSON.parse(data);
				console.log(response);
				console.log($avviso);

				$avviso.addClass('px-3 py-2 mt-2');

				if(response.stato){
					qta = parseInt(response.quantita);
					$avviso.removeClass('border border-danger text-danger').addClass('bg-pink text-white').html('Aggiunto al carrello');
					//fetch updated NAV
					$.get('/AJAX_navcart.php',function(data){
						var navHTML = data;
						$('#nav__sidecart').replaceWith(navHTML);
						var $badge = $('#nav__cart-badge')
						$badge.html(parseInt($badge.html())+qta);
						// send analytics event
						var p = window.prodotti[pid];

						//google
						ga('ec:addProduct', {
							  'id': p.prodotto_id,
							  'name': p.nome_prodotto,
							  'category': p.categoria,
							  'brand': p.brand,
							  'variant': p.confezione_da,
								'price': p.prezzo_visibile,
								'quantity': '1'
							});

							ga('ec:setAction', 'add');
						  ga('send','event','ecommerce','product add to cart',window.location.href);

						//facebook
						fbq('track', 'AddToCart', {
							content_name: p.nome_prodotto,
							  content_category: p.categoria,
							  content_ids: [pid],
							  content_type: 'product',
							  value: p.prezzo_visibile,
							  currency: 'EUR'
						  });

						//pinterest
						pintrk('track', 'AddToCart', {
						   line_items: [
							 {
							   product_name: p.nome_prodotto,
							   product_id: pid,
							   product_price: p.prezzo_visibile,
							   product_category: p.categoria,
							   product_quantity: 1
							 }
						   ]
						 });
					});
				} else {
					$avviso.removeClass('bg-pink text-white').addClass('border border-danger text-danger').html('Impossibile aggiungere al carrello');
				}
				endAjaxBtnAnimation($button);
				$button.removeAttr('disabled');
			});
		});

		//sidenav remove from cart
		$(document).on('click','.item_carrelloNav .cart-remove-button', function(e){
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopImmediatePropagation();
			var href = $(this).attr('href');
			var url_params = href.split('/');
			var c_id = url_params[4];
			var p_id = url_params[5];
			var s_id = url_params[6];
			var u_id = url_params[7];
			var productBox = $(this).closest('.sidecart__prodotto');
			var qta = productBox.attr('data-qta');
			$.post('/AJAX_remove_from_cart.php',{p_id:p_id,c_id:c_id,u_id:u_id,s_id:s_id},function(response){
				if(response){
					$.get('/AJAX_navcart.php',function(data){
						var navHTML = data;
						$('#nav__sidecart').replaceWith(navHTML);
						var $badge = $('#nav__cart-badge');
						$badge.html(parseInt($badge.html())-qta);
						if(!$('#sidecart-container').hasClass('move')){
							$('#sidecart-container').addClass('move');
						}
						if(!$('#nav__sidecart').hasClass('move')){
							$('#nav__sidecart').addClass('move');
						}
						var perc = $('.spedizione_gratuira_bar_inner.side').attr('data-value');
						$('.spedizione_gratuira_bar_inner.side').css('transition','all 0.6s ease').css('width',perc+'%');
						$('.prodloop__notice[data-pid="'+p_id+'"]').hide();
						// send analytics event
						var p = window.prodotti[p_id];
					});
				}
			});
		});

		$('.prodloop__addWishlistButton').on('click',function(e){
			if($(this).attr('disabled')){
				return false;
			}
			var pid = $(this).attr('data-pid');
			var $avviso = $('.prodloop__notice[data-pid='+pid+']');
			var $button = $(this);
			$(this).attr('disabled','disabled');
			startAjaxBtnAnimation($(this));
			$avviso.html('');
			$.post('/AJAX_add_to_wishlist.php',{prodotto_id:pid},function(data){
				var response = JSON.parse(data);
				console.log(response);
				console.log($avviso);

				$avviso.addClass('px-3 py-2 mt-2');

				if(response>0){
					$avviso.removeClass('border border-danger text-danger').addClass('bg-pink text-white').html('Aggiunto alla wishlist');
					var $badge = $('#nav__wishlist-badge')

				} else {
					$avviso.removeClass('bg-pink text-white').addClass('border border-danger text-danger').html('Impossibile aggiungere alla wishlist');
				}
				endAjaxBtnAnimation($button);
				$button.removeAttr('disabled');
			});
		});

		function startAjaxBtnAnimation($button){
			$button.addClass('pulse');
		}
		function endAjaxBtnAnimation($button){

			function sendProductClick(product, url) {
				ga('ec:addProduct', {               // Provide product details in a productFieldObject.
				  'id': product.prodotto_id,                   // Product ID (string).
				  'name': product.nome_prodotto, // Product name (string).
				  'category': product.categoria,            // Product category (string).
				  'brand': product.brand,                // Product brand (string).
				  'variant': product.confezione_da,               // Product variant (string).
				  'position': product.posizione                   // Product position (number).
				});

				ga('ec:setAction', 'click', {       // click action.
				  'list': 'Best Seller'          // Product list (string).
				});

		  		ga('send','event','ecommerce','product click', 'Homepage', {
					hitCallback: function() {
					  window.location.href = url;
					}
				});
			}


			$('.ecommerce-product-link').on('click',function(e){
				e.preventDefault();
				var pid = $(this).attr('data-product-id');
				var product = prodotti[pid];
				var url = $(this).attr('href');
				//console.log(product);
				sendProductClick(product, url)
			});
	  </script>
</body></html>
